title: I have a great narrative driven story with branching and choices and I need your advice
author: Nearby_Ad_3037
selftext: I have a great story 150k words with branching, I want to make something that’s is choices based driven, something like telltale and stuff but I am scared of one thing and that is consistency especially with faces. I tried training a Lora on my 6800 xt and its giving me consistent backgrounds and I use photoshop cloud pro (adobe) to fix everything else, but I was wondering if there is any better idea and more engaging  that I could use to develop my game using ai.

comments.author: No-Relief810
comments.body: [studio.meganova.ai](http://studio.meganova.ai)  this one help you create characters and benchmark it

replies.author: Nearby_Ad_3037
replies.body: Thank you so much I will give it a try.

comments.author: Defiant_Medicine_823
comments.body: Nano banana can handle consistent characters and Inpainting scenes

replies.author: Nearby_Ad_3037
replies.body: I will definitely try that do you think it can stay consistent for about 600 imagies or does it not have that capabilities yet

replies.author: Defiant_Medicine_823
replies.body: It definitely can, just be very clear with your expectations and if it starts to start a new agent/chat/whatever.

replies.author: Nearby_Ad_3037
replies.body: Alright from your perspective as a gamer would you enjoy a game like pentiment with voice acting, like 2 d game with a lot of scenes and a great story or something like a movie w choices and a great story also has voice acting.

replies.author: Defiant_Medicine_823
replies.body: I had to look up pentiment and upon a glance was immediately intrigued. I would need to see an example of your second example, but if this is targeted at gamers you want something they can I teach with and make depth filled choices. You should look up game development conference talks on YouTube. Game devs gather once a year and give in Depth lectures about this exact sort of subject.
